title: Secret Origins #28 DC July 1988 Midnight Nightshade Rob Liefeld Gil Kane
condition_description: Small chips and a stain along the spine edge of the back cover. See close-up.
description:
Secret Origins #28 (DC Comics, July 1988), origins of Midnight (by Roy Thomas & Gil Kane) and Nightshade (by Bob Greenberger, Rob Liefeld & Bob Lewis). $1.50 cover price.

Back cover: TSR Forgotten Realms Black Wizards ad.

Condition: front cover bright; small chips and a stain along the spine edge of the back cover (see close-up).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
